verdict.rationale: Bolt is built around natural-language operation. Projects start from a blank prompt, and the agents control the filesystem, terminal, package manager and server, deploying to production from chat. Plan Mode adds a chat-only mode, and the Prompt Library stores reusable prompts. Hands-on users corroborate this, one reporting 99% of edits were made through prompts, though others describe the agent making unwanted changes or getting stuck in fix/break loops. Those reports lower reliability but do not contradict that the product is prompt-driven. Missing for 10: evidence that account-level operations (settings, billing, domain setup) can also be done by natural language, and consistent reliability of prompt-driven changes.
